The PR description is incomplete relative to the diff. It mentions only `findings::summarise` (`shorten`, `first_sentence`) and frames the change as a non-mergeable end-to-end test. But the diff also materially edits deployment configuration: it turns on embeddings in `.tinysweeper.toml`, mounts that config into the container in `docker-compose.yml`, adds/renames required environment variables for OpenRouter/Cohere and GitHub App auth, and adds a new opt-in `docker-compose.kernel-bypass.yml` overlay plus a Python shim to work around a MongoDB 8.2 / Linux 6.19 startup check. None of that is mentioned in the body, and the body's claim that it 'adds `findings::summarise`' substantially undersells a PR that changes how the server authenticates and how the index is configured. The title ('Add a helper for shortening model-authored text') matches only the Rust module, not the compose/config changes. There is no finding against the code itself; the problem is the description.

Suggested replacement body:

End-to-end deployment validation. **Do not merge** — this exists to exercise the live server and will be closed.

## What changed

- **`src/findings/summarise.rs` (new):** `shorten(text, limit)` truncates to a word boundary using character (not byte) indexing so multibyte titles don't panic; `first_sentence(text)` returns the first sentence. Intended for check-run titles and one-line summaries. Includes unit tests for short input, word-boundary truncation, multibyte safety, and sentence extraction.
- **`.tinysweeper.toml`:** Enable embeddings via OpenRouter (`openai/text-embedding-3-small`, 1536 dims), keyed off `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. These fields are the index partition key; changing any of them invalidates existing vectors.
- **`docker-compose.yml`:** Forward `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and `COHERE_API_KEY`; rename `TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_APP_ID`/`TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY` to `TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID`/`TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` (the names `server::auth::AppAuth::from_env` actually reads), making both required; mount `.tinysweeper.toml` read-only into the container so `[embeddings]` is active.
- **`docker-compose.kernel-bypass.yml` (new, opt-in overlay):** For Linux 6.19+ where the MongoDB 8.2 community image refuses to start `mongod` due to a tcmalloc/glibc restartable-sequence interaction. Sets `GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=0` and overrides the entrypoint to a shim that no-ops `enforce_kernel_compatibility`.
- **`deploy/mongo/kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py` (new):** Python shim that patches the image entrypoint to replace `enforce_kernel_compatibility` with a no-op, fails loudly if the function no longer exists, and execs the real entrypoint. Development-only; not the default.

## Behaviour changes

- The server container now requires `TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID` and `TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` (previously defaulted to empty and silently failed auth). Deployments that relied on the old `TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_*` names must switch.
- Embeddings are on by default when the mounted config is present.
- No code path is changed other than the new `summarise` module; deployment-only and validation changes.

## Verification

Unit tests for `summarise`. This PR is the end-to-end validation itself: MongoDB 8.2 with mongot, hybrid search, OpenRouter embeddings, and the webhook path.
